operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog does not represent model log-likelihood estimation or differencing; log_transform applies a logarithm to supplied values and add performs element-wise addition.
The catalog has no score-computation primitive for deriving a mutation effect from model likelihoods.
The catalog does not encode model likelihood estimation or likelihood differences; its log_transform and add operations have different semantics.
A model-derived mutation-effect score is a computed evaluation quantity without a corresponding catalog operation.
